terms.definition: A quantity with magnitude only, such as speed, distance, mass or energy.
terms.examiner: Separate it from vectors in questions.

terms.definition: A quantity with magnitude and direction, such as velocity, displacement, force or acceleration.
terms.examiner: Shown as an arrow; the length represents the size.

terms.definition: A force where the objects are touching, such as friction, air resistance, tension or normal contact force.
terms.examiner: Non-contact forces: gravity, electrostatic and magnetic.

terms.definition: The force acting on an object due to gravity: W = m g.
terms.examiner: Measured with a newtonmeter; mass is in kg, weight in N.

terms.definition: The single point at which the weight of an object can be considered to act.
terms.examiner: For a symmetrical object it is at the centre.

terms.definition: A single force that has the same effect as all the forces acting together.
terms.examiner: Higher tier: resolve forces with a vector diagram.
